title: Colchicine for major adverse cardiovascular events in coronary disease
question: Does low-dose colchicine reduce major adverse cardiovascular events in patients with established coronary artery disease or after myocardial infarction?

question_provenance.why: The parent `colchicine-cvd-review` asked one question of trials in three different vascular beds. This reading is the coronary one.

split_provenance.why_split: The parent held COLCOT (after myocardial infarction), CLEAR SYNERGY (after myocardial infarction, inside a 2x2 factorial) and CONVINCE (after NON-CARDIOEMBOLIC ISCHAEMIC STROKE) under one question. The complete 137-record search added peripheral artery disease, intracerebral haemorrhage, peri-procedural prevention and pericarditis. Seven readings; see DECIDED-colchicine-cvd-2026-08-19.md. P21.
split_provenance.siblings_state: NOT YET BUILT. This is the first of the seven. Naming them here before they exist is deliberate: a reading that is named and unbuilt is visible, and a reading that is neither is not.
split_provenance.precedence: PERIPROC > PERICARD > ICH > CEREBRO > PAD > CORONARY, applied in that order and STATED rather than discovered. A different precedence would move trials between readings and these counts would change with it. PERIPROC requires BOTH a procedural anchor AND a primary outcome that is a complication of the procedure, because a 'was a procedure involved' rule sends CLEAR SYNERGY out of its own review.
split_provenance.the_seventh_reading_was_an_amendment: Six readings were fixed before any count existed. The screen then surfaced a population none of them covered -- established atherosclerotic disease with no named vascular bed -- and ASCVD_MIXED was added as a DATED AMENDMENT rather than folded back into the original six.

mace.estimator_note: Nothing is pooled as this page's answer. Two pools WERE computed so their cost is measured rather than asserted, and both are reported below as declined. Both use Paule-Mandel between-study variance with a floored Knapp-Hartung t interval; DerSimonian-Laird is refused below k=10 by the house rule. At k=2 the Knapp-Hartung multiplier is 12.706 on one degree of freedom, which is why that interval is enormous -- correct behaviour, and a reason a k=2 Knapp-Hartung interval must never be read as a precision statement.
mace.poolable_reason: THE THREE TRIALS DO NOT SHARE AN ENDPOINT. Decomposed into components and compared as SETS rather than by name, the union is TEN components and exactly ONE -- cardiovascular death -- is common to all three. RESUSCITATED CARDIAC ARREST is in COLCOT and in neither of the others: a whole component present in one arm of the comparison and absent from the rest. MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION is ANY in COLCOT, SPONTANEOUS (NONPROCEDURAL) ONLY in LoDoCo2, and RECURRENT in CLEAR SYNERGY -- and LoDoCo2's qualifier EXCLUDES periprocedural infarction in a literature where a large share of infarctions are periprocedural. STROKE is ANY TYPE in COLCOT and CLEAR SYNERGY and ISCHAEMIC ONLY in LoDoCo2; colchicine's effect in intracerebral haemorrhage is an open question with its own reading in this split, so a trial counting only ischaemic strokes and a trial counting every stroke are measuring the drug against different risks. REVASCULARISATION requires an URGENT HOSPITALISATION FOR ANGINA in COLCOT, is ISCHAEMIA-DRIVEN in LoDoCo2, and is UNPLANNED AND ISCHAEMIA-DRIVEN in CLEAR SYNERGY. A pool of these three would report a number for a quantity no trial measured.

pooled.card_note: the three trials share ONE component of TEN; each trial's own result and its own endpoint definition are on the page

effect_measure: all three publish a hazard ratio
population: COLCOT and CLEAR SYNERGY enrol after myocardial infarction; LoDoCo2 enrols chronic coronary disease

mace.heterogeneity_status: Reported for the DECLINED pools only, and it settles nothing either way. The name-matched k=3 pool has I-squared 77.9%% and it is also the estimand-INCOHERENT one, so here a statistic and a reading of the definitions happen to agree. On `apixaban-vte-treatment` they pointed in OPPOSITE directions -- the estimand-coherent pool was the MORE heterogeneous. P36 stands: a low I-squared does not show trials measure the same thing and a high one does not show they do not. Coherence was established here by reading ten component definitions.

name_matched_k3.why_it_is_not_reported_as_the_result: The three primaries differ by a whole component and by three qualifiers. Averaging them produces a number for a quantity no trial measured.

mi_population_k2.estimator: Paule-Mandel tau-squared, Knapp-Hartung t interval on 1 df with the variance-inflation floor at 1
mi_population_k2.what_it_is: COLCOT and CLEAR SYNERGY -- the two whose population is AFTER MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION, so the population axis is coherent.
mi_population_k2.why_it_is_still_not_reported: THE POPULATION MATCHING DOES NOT FIX THE ESTIMAND. COLCOT counts resuscitated cardiac arrest and CLEAR SYNERGY does not; COLCOT's revascularisation limb requires an urgent hospitalisation for angina and CLEAR SYNERGY's requires only that the revascularisation be unplanned and ischaemia-driven. A shared population is NECESSARY and it is NOT SUFFICIENT -- the same shape as P38, one axis down.

the_pools_this_refusal_declines_to_repor.why_both_are_shown: A refusal that names no number is not checkable. Both are computed, both are labelled as NOT this page's answer, and the second exists to make a separate point: MATCHING THE POPULATION DOES NOT FIX THE ESTIMAND. COLCOT and CLEAR SYNERGY share a population and still differ by a whole component and by their revascularisation trigger. P38, one axis down.

mace.withholding_question_summary: NAMED, not general. (1) CARDIOVASCULAR DEATH is the one component all three share, and only COLCOT publishes it separately -- 1 of 3. (2) LoDoCo2's KEY SECONDARY is the nearest thing to a common estimand and NEITHER of the other two reports that composite at all -- 1 of 3. (3) CLEAR SYNERGY reports its components in words and not in numbers, so it cannot join ANY component-level pool from this source. THE BLOCKER IS CLEAR SYNERGY'S REPORTING, AND IT IS THE LARGEST OF THE THREE. Reading its full text is the single action that would change this page's answer.

screening.search_note: Two searches, both exhausted, both with their identifier lists written down and their arithmetic re-derivable by scripts/verify_search_record_reconciles.py.
screening.eligibility: PREDEFINED: no. Derived post hoc on 2026-08-19 when colchicine-cvd-review was split into seven readings. A trial is in THIS reading when its population is established coronary artery disease or recent myocardial infarction, read from the coded conditions and, where those name something true but not the population's vascular disease, from the trial's own title with the fallback recorded. It is ELIGIBLE when colchicine is the randomised contrast, the allocation is RANDOMIZED, and the registration declares at least two arms. A PRECEDENCE RULE ASSIGNS EVERY RECORD TO EXACTLY ONE READING and it is published in full on this page, because a rule that decides inclusion and is published nowhere is not a criterion but a habit.

eligibility_provenance.precedence: PERIPROC > PERICARD > ICH > CEREBRO > PAD > CORONARY, applied in that order and STATED rather than discovered. A different precedence would move trials between readings and these counts would change with it. PERIPROC requires BOTH a procedural anchor AND a primary outcome that is a complication of the procedure, because a 'was a procedure involved' rule sends CLEAR SYNERGY out of its own review.
eligibility_provenance.why_that_matters: A precedence rule applied FIRST is the most damaging place to be wrong, because it removes trials from every downstream reading before any of them can judge them (P43). Ten known members were named in the decision document BEFORE the screen ran and the screen refuses to write anything if one lands elsewhere.

duplicate_screening.state: OWED, AND RECORDED AS OWED RATHER THAN DESCRIBED
duplicate_screening.what_was_NOT_done: No second model family read this screen. An agreement rate over one reader is not an agreement rate.

screening.boundary_criterion: PERIPROC BEFORE CORONARY, and it is defined by WHAT THE PRIMARY OUTCOME IS -- a complication of an operation or catheter procedure -- never by a procedure having occurred. CLEAR SYNERGY randomises myocardial-infarction patients undergoing PCI, so a 'was a procedure involved' rule would have taken THE LARGEST TRIAL IN THIS REVIEW out of it.

screening_of_remainder.what_the_split_diagnoses: 53 records are ELIGIBLE_COMPLETED_NO_RESULTS_POSTED against 33 ELIGIBLE_NO_RESULTS_YET. Folded together as 'no results' they read as a field still in flight; separated, FIFTY-THREE COMPLETED TRIALS HAVE POSTED NOTHING TO THIS REGISTRY. That is a fact about the database and about publication, and it is why the PubMed limb was not optional here.
screening_of_remainder.PUBMED_REMAINDER_IS_NOT_SCREENED_AND_THA: The 523 PubMed records establish the denominator and recall. NO DISPOSITION HAS BEEN APPLIED TO ANY OF THEM. Three publications were read; 520 were not. This is an UNSCREENED REMAINDER on the PubMed limb and it is stated rather than reported as zero -- E9, absence of a count is not a count of zero.

withholding_question.question: Before concluding that nothing pools, is there a lower-ranked outcome at which these trials DO share an estimand?
withholding_question.answer: ASKED AT EVERY RANK THESE SOURCES REACH, AND BLOCKED BY A NAMED TRIAL
withholding_question.detail: Before concluding that nothing pools, the question is put at every rank the sources reach. LoDoCo2 publishes a KEY SECONDARY -- 'a composite of cardiovascular death, spontaneous myocardial infarction, or ischemic stroke', HR 0.72 (0.57 to 0.92) -- which drops revascularisation and is the closest thing to a common estimand in these three papers. NEITHER COLCOT NOR CLEAR SYNERGY REPORTS THAT COMPOSITE IN ITS ABSTRACT. COLCOT does publish every component of its own primary separately, and CLEAR SYNERGY says only that 'the incidence of individual components of the primary outcome appeared to be similar in the two groups' WITHOUT NUMBERS. SO THE ANSWER IS NOT 'NOTHING POOLS'. It is that a component-level or key-secondary-level pool WOULD REQUIRE THE FULL TEXTS, which this pass did not read. That is OWED WORK, recorded as owed, and it is NOT a negative finding -- an absence of a reading is not a reading of absence.
withholding_question.why_the_distinction_matters: On `apixaban-vte-prophylaxis` this question moved the poolable set from 3 to 8; on `apixaban-vte-treatment` it moved it from 8 to 3; on `bococizumab-lipid` it moved nothing. It is a CHECK, not a way of finding more trials, and here its honest answer is that the full texts were not read. AN ABSENCE OF A READING IS NOT A READING OF ABSENCE.
withholding_question.what_rank_means_here: The abstracts are the source, so 'every rank' means every rank an abstract prints: the primary, any key secondary, and any component of the primary reported separately. Full texts were not read and would reach further; that limit is stated per trial below rather than left as a general caveat.

withholding_question.what_would_change_the_answer: The full texts, in this order of expected yield: CLEAR SYNERGY (component counts), LoDoCo2 (cardiovascular death alone, and its components), COLCOT (already component-complete in its abstract). grade.why: GRADE rates a body of evidence for an OUTCOME. This page establishes that the three trials do not share one, so there is no single outcome to rate. Rating the name-matched pool would certify a quantity no trial measured.
